content.text:
Perfect! All 46 tests pass. I've added two functions to manage invoice lines:

**addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })** — Adds a new line or updates qty if SKU already exists:
- Validates qty is a positive integer (QTY_INVALID)
- Validates sku exists (UNKNOWN_SKU)
- Rejects non-draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT)
- Returns new invoice without mutating the original

**removeLine(invoice, sku)** — Removes a line by SKU:
- Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice
- Returns NO_LINES if it would remove the last line
- Rejects non-draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT)
- Returns new invoice without mutating the original

Added 12 tests covering:
- Adding new lines and updating existing SKUs
- Validation (qty, sku, draft status)
- Error cases (not found, last line, non-draft)
- No mutation of original invoices

Added two new error codes: LINE_NOT_FOUND and NOT_DRAFT. All tests pass.
